zh-CN.title: 八仙活动细节优化
items: 八仙聚力活动的唤醒轨迹加入轻盈毛玻璃承托，信息层次更清楚
言浪方形 Logo 现在会稳定显示在白边圆角容器内
八位仙人按唤醒顺序展开，未解锁时呈现剪影，解锁后会展示彩色人物与唤醒成员头像

en.title: Refined Baxian event details
items: The Baxian awakening trail now rests on a subtle glass surface for clearer visual hierarchy
The square Sermo logo now stays correctly framed inside its rounded white-border container
All eight immortals now form an awakening trail with silhouettes for locked stages and contributor portraits for unlocked stages
